title: ARV Moment
description: A range on an asset. Identity is the canonical range after snapping. Chapters, shots, windows and spans are all moments; kind labels which one the origin published. end_ms stays on the moment for rights and receipts; players do not enforce it.

arv.description: ARV version. Every ARV object carries "arv": "1.0".

id.description: "mom_" + first 26 characters of lowercase base32 (RFC 4648, no padding) of SHA-256 over "{origin}|{asset_id}|{start_ms}|{end_ms}". Recomputable by anyone.

moment_uri.description: arv:{asset_id}#t={start_ms},{end_ms}. The canonical snapped range is the moment's identity.

moment_url.description: https deep link that opens the video at start_ms, using a start-only Media Fragment in seconds (#t=12.4) or the player's own start parameter. It MUST NOT carry an end in a Media Fragment, because players stop at a fragment end.

snap.description: The snap rule used. Omitted when the producer does not know it.

kind.description: What the origin published this range as: chapter (a titled section), shot (one continuous camera take), window (a short range used for visual description) or span (any other evidence-backed range). Optional. It never changes the moment's identity.

summary.description: A short plain summary of the range.

visual_description.description: What is on screen in the range, in plain words.

evidence.description: Typed spans, each fully inside [start_ms, end_ms].

evidence_grade.description: A human-verified; B machine-produced and passed an automated quality check that the producer documents publicly; C machine-produced with at least one direct span inside the range; D metadata or inference only.

aliases.description: Earlier ids for the same moment, for example an id from an older numbering scheme, so old references keep resolving.

products.description: Products, services or works the range shows or mentions. Discovery data: never a media URL.

actions.description: Links the publisher offers the viewer (buy, book, subscribe, learn). Separate from entitlement and playback.

speaker_id.description: On a transcript span: the id of the speaker in the asset's speakers list.

evidence_span.description: A typed span of evidence. Times are absolute milliseconds on the asset.

product.description: A product, service or work that a range shows or mentions.

kind.description: service is something a person books or receives from a provider (an appointment, a class). online_service is a website or platform a person uses.

relation.description: shown: on screen. mentioned: named in speech or text only.

url.description: https link to the merchant or publisher page. Never a media URL.

evidence.description: Spans where the product appears. Inside the moment range on a Moment, inside duration_ms on an Asset.

action.description: A link the publisher offers the viewer. It is an offer, not an access requirement: entitlement and payment stay in RightsSummary and PlaybackDescriptor.

label.description: The text a consumer shows, for example "Book a tune-up".

url.description: https link the viewer opens. Never a media URL that plays without an origin check.
